description: 🚀 More FPS Modpack is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack designed to boost FPS, reduce lag, improve chunk loading, and provide a smoother gameplay experience. Perfect for low-end PCs and players who want maximum performance
body:
### More FPS Modpack

More FPS Modpack is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to make the game run as smoothly as possible on low-end and mid-range computers. It includes carefully selected optimization mods that improve FPS, reduce stuttering, speed up chunk loading, lower memory usage, and make world generation more efficient.

Whether you're playing survival, PvP, or exploring large modded worlds, More FPS Modpack helps Minecraft feel faster and more responsive without changing the vanilla experience.

What This Modpack Does
- 🚀 Increases FPS significantly
- ⚡ Reduces lag spikes and stuttering
- 🌍 Improves chunk loading speed
- 💾 Lowers RAM usage
- 🔧 Optimizes rendering performance
- 🎮 Makes Minecraft smoother on low-end PCs
- 📦 Maintains a mostly vanilla gameplay experience
- 🔄 Improves loading times
  

## 🎮 Best Minecraft Settings for Low-End & Potato PCs

**These settings are recommended for maximum FPS when using More FPS Modpack.**

## **_Video Settings_**
- Graphics: Fast
- Render Distance: 6-12 Chunks
- Simulation Distance: 4 Chunks
- Max Framerate: Unlimited
- V-Sync: OFF
- View Bobbing: OFF
- GUI Scale: Auto
- Brightness: 100%
- Attack Indicator: Crosshair
- Dynamic Lights: OFF or ON
- Dynamic FOV: OFF
- Quality Settings
- Mipmap Levels: 0
- Biome Blend: OFF (0x0)
- Entity Distance: 50%
- Entity Shadows: OFF
- Clouds: OFF
- Particles: Minimal
- Distortion Effects: 0%
- FOV Effects: 0%
## Details Settings
- Sky: OFF
- Sun & Moon: OFF
- Fog: OFF
- Rain & Snow: OFF
- Stars: OFF
- Swamp Colors: OFF
- Alternate Blocks: OFF
- Performance Settings
- Chunk Updates: 1
- Smart Animations: ON
- Fast Render: ON (if available)
- Fast Math: ON
- Lazy Chunk Loading: ON (if available)
- Always Defer Chunk Updates: ON
  
## Animations
- Water Animation: OFF
- Lava Animation: OFF
- Fire Animation: OFF
- Portal Animation: OFF
- Redstone Animation: OFF
- Explosion Animation: OFF
- Smoke Animation: OFF
- Terrain Animation: OFF
- Particle Animation: OFF
Resource Packs
- Use 16x or 8x texture packs.
- try to Avoid shaders on low-end PCs.
- Disable unnecessary resource packs.
- **_Note:These settings are optimized for maximum FPS on most low-end PCs. Feel free to customize them according to your hardware and personal preferences to achieve the best balance between performance and visual quality._**
